study_type_evidence.quote: the mice were injected intravenously (bolus) with 125I-labelled proteins in the tail vein
Blood was separated into blood pellet and plasma by centrifugation 10, 000 × g, 5 min at 4 °C.
The ability of sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 and muNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 to degrade Aβ in vitro was evaluated using an assay similar to what has been described previously

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: tg-ArcSwe transgenic, 7-8 months old, both females and males (females 21.2-30 g, males 30.8-36 g)
in_vivo_species.quote: Tg-ArcSwe mice of 7–8 months old were used... Both females and males were included (weight range: females 21.2–30 g, males 30.8–36 g).

ex_vivo_detail: Mouse blood collected after in vivo dosing was separated into blood pellet and plasma; plasma and urine were then applied to iTLC plates to confirm that the measured radioactivity corresponded to intact protein rather than free iodine. Brain hemispheres were homogenized ex vivo into TBS, TBS-T and formic-acid Aβ extracts for ELISA quantification.
in_vitro_detail: Cell-free Aβ degradation assay: synthetic Aβ1-40, Aβ1-42 or arctic Aβ1-42 (0.5 or 2.5 μM) co-incubated with 0.5 μM recombinant NEP proteins at 37 °C for 2.5-72 h, read by sandwich ELISA. Also TfR- and Aβ-binding ELISAs on coated plates and Tycho nt.6 thermal stability of purified proteins. Proteins were expressed in Expi293 cells.

agents.name: [125I]sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3
agents.sequence_source: body gives only domain composition (sNEP = amino acid 52-749 of NEP, scFc of mouse IgG2c, scFv8D3) and linkers (APGSGGGSGPA; P(G4S)3; (G4S)3); no full amino acid sequence is printed
agents.chemical_identifier: Mw 162 kDa; labelled with 125-iodine (Perkin Elmer); specific activity 28 MBq/nmol
agents.group_n: n = 4 (therapeutic study, Methods); n = 3 per timepoint at 2, 6 and 72 h in the tracer study. Fig. 6 caption instead states n = 4
agents.dose: 5 mg/kg body weight (~30 nmol/kg) therapeutic dose; 0.05 mg/kg (0.3 nmol/kg) tracer dose
agents.dose_route_quote: mice were injected 125I-labelled proteins with a dose of 5 mg/kg body weight of [125I]sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3
agents.pk_quote: Elimination half-life was estimated to 16 h and 18 h for sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 and muNEP-scFc-scFv8D3, respectively (Fig. 6E).

agents.dose_route_quote: a dose of 5 mg/kg body weight of [125I]sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 or [125I]muNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 (corresponding to around 30 nmol/kg body weight

agents.sequence_source: body states only that scFc was recombinantly linked to scFv8D3; no amino acid sequence is printed

agents.dose_route_quote: 2.5 mg/kg of [125I]scFv8D3-scFc (corresponding to around 30 nmol/kg body weight; Mw 81 kDa, n = 4)
agents.half_life: not reported numerically; body states it is approximately twofold longer than the two NEP constructs
agents.pk_quote: A twofold longer blood half-life was calculated for scFc-scFv8D3 (Fig. 6E).

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: E Blood pharmacokinetics of the three injected proteins. Shorter half-lives were detected for [125I]sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 and [125I]muNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 compared to [125I]scFc-scFv8D3.
concentration_time_figure.note: Blood radioactivity vs time after a single IV therapeutic dose; samples at 1, 4, 6, 24, 48 and 72 h. Fig. 6F shows the corresponding blood AUC. Fig. 5E shows organ biodistribution at 2, 6 and 72 h after the tracer dose.

bioanalytical_method: Gamma counting of 125I radioactivity (Wizard 2470 gamma counter), expressed as %ID/g; instant thin layer chromatography (iTLC) with phosphoimager readout to confirm intact labelled protein in plasma and urine; sandwich ELISA for Aβ quantification
bioanalytical_quote: measuring the radioactivity in blood samples, brain parts and organs by using a Wizard 2470 gamma counter
notes: Blood half-life values (16 h, 18 h) come from the therapeutic-dose study (30 nmol/kg IV) and are read from Fig. 6E; no Cmax or Tmax is reported anywhere in the body. The Methods and the Fig. 6/Fig. 7 captions disagree on group sizes (Methods: sNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 n = 4, muNEP-scFc-scFv8D3 n = 3, scFc-scFv8D3 n = 4; Fig. 6/7 captions: n = 4 for both NEP constructs, n = 3 for scFc-scFv8D3); both are recorded above. The Limitations section acknowledges n = 3-4 per treatment group. No absolute half-life value is given for the scFc-scFv8D3 control; the body only states it is twofold longer (Fig. 6E is said to carry values in brackets, but those numbers are not in the text). Amino acid sequences for all three constructs are absent from the body — the long sequences shown in the PEPLIFE2 header are database metadata and were not used. Synthetic Aβ1-40, Aβ1-42 and arctic Aβ1-42 were substrates in the degradation assay rather than administered agents and are not listed as agents. An IgG2c isotype antibody was used only as an SDS-PAGE loading control.
